mapper.insert: insert into dept (name, contact_person, contact_phone, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select id, name, contact_person, contact_phone, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from dept where status = 1 order by id asc

select id, name, contact_person, contact_phone, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from dept
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by create_time desc, id desc
